newsitem.title: USA: Municipal sales total $169 mln for Tuesday Nov 26.
newsitem.headline: Municipal sales total $169 mln for Tuesday Nov 26.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $169 million in 24 offerings for Tuesday, November 26, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $131.5 million in 20 issues. The largest is a $39.4 million Newark, N.J., at 1100 EST.
Negotiated sales total $37.9 million in four offerings for the week. The largest issue is a $13 million Akron, Ohio, issue through AG Edwards & Co.

There are four three issues totaling $410.8 million on the Reuters day-to-day calendar, meaning underwriters have indicated they may price them on November 26 depending on market conditions. --U.S. Municipal Information Group, 212-859-1826
